question: In which year was The Municipal Corporation in Calcutta set up by a royal charter?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1726.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Municipal Corporation in Calcutta** was established by a** royal charter** granted by** King George I **in the year** 1726.**
 
• The corporation was responsible for the** administration **of the city of Calcutta, which was then the** capital of British India.**
 
• The Calcutta Municipal Corporation was the** first municipal corporation** to be set up in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** municipal government of Kolkata**, the state capital of **West Bengal**, is known as the** Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC).**
 
• This civic administrative entity is responsible for** 206.08 square kilometers** of territory.
 
• Its insignia bears the Bengali script slogan,** Purosri Bibardhan.**
